FLASH_LOAN.look_for: Any state readable in 1 tx that affects pricing/voting/access
FLASH_LOAN.defense: TWAP, snapshots, accumulate over time, virtual shares
FLASH_LOAN.tool: Echidna: flash loan invariant (state before == state after flash loan tx)

ORACLE_MANIPULATION.look_for: Oracle source that can change within 1 tx
ORACLE_MANIPULATION.tool: Z3: prove price change bounded by X% per block

REENTRANCY.look_for: External call before state update, cross-function state reads
red_flags: read state in function B that A should update
REENTRANCY.defense: CEI, reentrancy guard, transient storage locks

GOVERNANCE_ATTACK.look_for: Voting power read at vote time (not snapshot)
GOVERNANCE_ATTACK.defense: Snapshot at proposal creation, timelock, veToken
GOVERNANCE_ATTACK.tool: Manual: trace voting power source to balanceOf

KEY/ACCESS_COMPROMISE.look_for: Low multisig threshold, single admin, no timelock
KEY/ACCESS_COMPROMISE.defense: High threshold, timelocks, multi-sig for admin

SHARE_INFLATION.look_for: totalAssets reads balanceOf(this) instead of internal accounting
SHARE_INFLATION.defense: Virtual shares (OZ method), internal accounting, dead shares

LIQUIDATION_BUG.defense: Health check after EVERY position change

CALCULATION_ERROR.defense: Unit tests with known values, Z3 formal verification
CALCULATION_ERROR.tool: Z3: prove formula bounds. Custom Slither: FeeCapInconsistency (already built!)
